name: hold
_note: the top hand curled a little over the bump (still q_k4_down_0; Harry on v5: 'rather than being a little curled over the top of the bump'): LONG fingers lying TOGETHER along the dome, the spread closed a few degrees toward the middle finger and the curl graded mildly (index ~30° tip to knuckle, little finger ~60°) so the tips step without the gaps opening; the thumb tucked along the hand's top edge. Works with her LEFT hand drawn from the back (thumbSide −1, lesson 53) placed palm DOWN onto the dome (hand_place --palm-down 0.55): on a palm-down hand a 3D curl swings the more curled fingers sideways, so a steep grade fans them apart. Tried: 70-85° ('a mitten'), 45-65° unplaced ('straight planks'), 65-85° placed ('a paw'); v7 drafts (on the mirrored hand): together with thin lines ('a fused mitten'), fanned ±10° with ~90° on the little finger ('a claw'). Picked side by side with the still, zoomed and at film size (tools/hand_shapes.py, lessons 51-53)
